summary: Recommended (P2r): colour definitions 142 → 94 (54 still referenced by a rendered rule; org: 21), text styles 18 → 16 (org 7), radii 14 → 10 (org 17), font sizes 12 → 9 (org 4), spacing kept at 18 steps (P2: 13, org 10). Measured on the built app (45,368 elements, 104 reproducible states, light + dark): colour ΔE2000 max 2.90, mean 0.030, 99.53% of 73,550 declarations at or under 2, 0 above 5; type: 11 font-size and 721 line-height changes of at most 1px; QA before/after pixel diff at most 0.062%; WCAG: 0 text/surface pairs cross 3 / 4.5 / 7. Spacing snapping is the only family that moves pixels (up to 1.54%), so it is an optional separate step. The org breadth is not reachable at ΔE ≤ 5: the floor is ~54 colour definitions because the Creator renders a blue accent, stage glass, translucent inks and materials the org has no vocabulary for.
